name: Jaime Bicknell
bio: Clinical Associate Professor of Physical Therapy and Director of Clinical Education at Clarkson, where she earned her BS, MPT, and DPT. A board-certified specialist in women's health physical therapy (WCS) with CAPP-Pelvic certification, she owns You First Women's Health Physical Therapy and previously practiced at Canton Potsdam Hospital from 2007 to 2018. She was named to NNY Business Magazine's 20 Under 40 in 2020.
